description: Breaking the scaffolding the player is in: climbing a column from inside with jump held while breaking the piece at its feet (looking down), so the pieces above go too; standing inside and breaking its own piece; sneaking down while breaking; climbing while breaking the piece above; with scaffolding in hand (its outline a full block, so the piece at eye height is hit from inside) standing, climbing and sneaking while breaking.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
